t: The Lutec Briti outdoor LED solar floodlight provides robust security and enhanced visibility for various properties. This wall-mounted solar-powered light delivers a powerful 750 lumens of daylight white illumination, ideal for lighting driveways, gardens, and outdoor entrances. Featuring three independently adjustable LED heads, it offers wide-area coverage. An integrated PIR sensor with an 8m range ensures responsive lighting, offering 3 distinct modes for flexible operation; light only when motion is detected, a low glow during the night or a low glow that boosts to full light output when motion is detected. Constructed from durable IP44-rated polycarbonate, this floodlight withstands diverse weather conditions, ensuring reliable year-round performance without the need for complex wiring, making it a practical and efficient security solution.
b: Easy to Install & No Wiring Required
